why_ai: Value is physical parts made on factory floors; AI cannot substitute production, though OEMs treat CMs as commodities.
why_clarity: OEM specs define exact parts, processes are codified and runs repeat at scale.
why_digital: Physical materials become physical goods on factory lines, though bidding and offshore sourcing are routine.

why_ai: Flight-critical parts are physically machined under AS9100 and DCMA oversight with accountable quality sign-off.
why_clarity: Drawings and AS9102 inspection give exact pass criteria, though part numbers vary widely.
why_digital: Raw stock is machined into physical parts on CNC floors and shipped to primes.

why_ai: Multi-year programme bets at thin margins are high-stakes judgment, but the work is screen-based modelling.
why_clarity: RFQs recur often, but quote accuracy is known only after years of actual programme costs.
why_digital: Drawings, BOMs and cost data in, quotes and models produced on screen.

why_ai: Curating datasheets and change notices into structured data is extraction work AI performs well.

why_digital: Datasheets and notices in, a subscription database delivered online.

why_ai: Boards are physically assembled on SMT lines; buyers keep paying for production, chosen on price.

why_digital: Physical components become physical boards, though EMS work is routinely sourced abroad.

why_ai: ECO impact assessment follows deterministic BOM traversal and rule checks that AI can perform.

why_digital: PLM records and BOMs in, impact assessments produced and delivered on screen.

why_ai: Analysts physically decapsulate and section parts, and findings assign blame in disputes.

why_digital: Failed physical parts are shipped in for lab work; the deliverable is a written report.

why_ai: Authority comes from industry consensus and recognition, which AI-generated text cannot replicate.

why_ai: Survey analysis and forecasting are screen work AI accelerates, kept alive by association brand.

why_ai: Curating property data from datasheets and standards is extraction work AI does increasingly well.

why_digital: Literature and datasheets in, a searchable database delivered online.

why_ai: Devices are physically made under FDA Part 820, and validated suppliers are costly to switch.

why_digital: Physical materials are made into devices on validated lines and shipped.

why_ai: Writing process libraries and compliance content from deployment data is screen work AI generates readily.
why_clarity: Content items are defined library entries produced repeatedly against release cycles.
why_digital: Data and documents in, software content shipped inside platforms.

why_ai: Defined acceptance criteria applied to images are exactly what machine vision replaces.
why_clarity: Accept or reject against workmanship standards is checkable and repeated thousands of times.
why_digital: Physical parts are inspected on the floor, increasingly through cameras and images.

why_ai: Regulation requires credible human assessment of smelters, and buyers rely on the programme's standing.

why_ai: Job shops physically make varied parts, and AI cannot substitute the production.
